result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is clipped to 'Tokumaru Ramer' in the Popular right now section.

issues.description: Restaurant name under 'Popular right now' reads 'Tokumaru Ramer' with the final character clipped off, likely should be 'Tokumaru Ramen'. The text appears cut mid-letter despite available space before the rating.
issues.suggestion: Fix the title container width, padding or overflow handling so the full restaurant name displays without clipping; use ellipsis only if the name truly overflows.
